AMENDMENT_CLASSIFICATION: PROSPECTIVE_NORMATIVE_SCOPE_ADDITION; adopted generic required-source meaning not claimed
BOUNDARY_RULE: Current accepted typed-proof admissions needed to establish the sole declared E2-ROOT goal via its native declared Slot support; include every actual applicable proof in this fixed chain, no alternative suppressed
CLOSED_WORLD_SCOPE: Exact accepted proof inventory in fixed sealed snapshot and declared support chain; scope is newly proposed, not inferred frozen authority
EXCLUSION_PREDICATE: Outside direct admission-provenance withdrawal scope of this proposed test domain, not global inapplicability or historical exclusion
INCLUSION_PREDICATE: source is exactly an owned current accepted proof.provenance.identity at sealed state; complete kind/namespace/hash equality; exact physical pin/native stale rule
PROOF_PATH_REQUIREDNESS: Every declared support/fingerprint mandatory within each existing native proof; raw provenance is separately a validity dependency, not a supports member
QUALIFICATION_COVERAGE_REQUIREDNESS: Propose testing each owned admission own-provenance validation withdrawal exactly once; all other pin/currentness inputs remain validation/supporting context, not direct targets in this purpose-specific design
RATIONALE: Coverage follows all scoped accepted admissions and a predeclared validity-dependency role, not which arbitrary source happens to pass
TARGET_SATISFACTION_REQUIREDNESS: Reevaluate all applicable usable proofs; common configuration withdrawal leaves no retained alternative for this scenario. Not a rule that every dependency is individually target-necessary in general.
